The '''Mina-Rau system''' was a [[Star system]] located in the [[D'Astan sector|D'Astan]] [[sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The system was located in grid square O-6 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], and contained<ref name="Harvest" /> the [[Agriworld|agricultural]]<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> [[planet]] of [[Mina-Rau]].<ref name="Harvest" />
